description: Industry-neutral entities and relations for corporate intelligence.

entities.organization: A specifically named legal or operating entity: company, public body, institution, supplier, customer, association or group. Never a generic plural category.
entities.brand: A named commercial brand or sub-brand, distinct from its legal operator when the text makes that distinction.
entities.person: A named natural person: executive, director, inspector, founder, spokesperson or public official. Never label a company, product or service as a person.
entities.product: A specifically named physical or digital product, platform, tool, instrument or technology.
entities.offering: A named commercial programme, package, membership, contract, certification scheme or customer-facing offering.
entities.service: A concrete service or activity delivered, purchased, audited, inspected, certified, managed or supported.
entities.asset: A named or described physical asset, facility, site, infrastructure, equipment or system.
entities.standard: A named regulation, standard, code, framework, protocol or technical specification.
entities.certification: A named certificate, accreditation, conformity assessment or certification outcome.
entities.customer_segment: A buyer, customer, audience or beneficiary group. Not a service provider.
entities.location: A named country, city, region, site, facility, airport, port or other geographic place.
entities.date: An explicit date, month, year, deadline or clearly stated time period.
entities.monetary_value: An explicit financial amount, preserving currency and scale.
entities.metric: An explicit measurable quantity, percentage, count, capacity, duration or performance figure with its stated unit.

relations.name: contracts_with

relations.name: appointed

relations.name: provides_service
